title: Darkhold Arena (v10)
description: Wave-based arena RPG. Choose Sorcerer, Wizard, or Knight — destroy walls, collect tokens, upgrade abilities, and survive. Sorcerer skeletons now last 15s and explode destroying nearby walls.
prompt: change the skeleton timer from 60 seconds to 15 seconds for the sorcerer. When the skeleton explodes also make it destroy any walls nearby.
